column3: Night train moving. Orange city lights slide past outside the rain-streaked window, reflections drift across the glass over his face. He stays almost still, tired eyes looking out, a slow blink. Gentle train sway. Sound of train wheels on rails and rain.
He walks slowly away from camera down the wet street carrying the suitcase, rain falling, the street lamp flickers. Static wide camera. Sound of rain and distant footsteps.
Very slow push in toward the abandoned theater facade. Rain falls through the weak sodium lamp light, a loose poster flaps in the wind. Sound of heavy rain.
He pushes the heavy padded doors open slowly and stands in the doorway, pale light and floating dust pour in around his silhouette. Sound of creaking hinges.

Slow steady dolly forward down the center aisle of the empty abandoned theater, dust drifting in light shafts, rain dripping onto the stage. No people. Sound of dripping water echoing in a large empty hall.

Static camera, very slow push in. He sits still in the dark theater; faint music reaches him, his eyes slowly shift toward the stage and his breath catches. Subtle micro-expressions. Dust drifts through the light.

Slow push in on the cassette recorder on the stage floor. The tape reels inside begin to turn by themselves, the red light glows. Faint old song with a male voice and electric guitar plays from its small speaker, tinny and distant.

He sings into the microphone with eyes closed, playing the electric guitar, swaying with the song, smoke drifts through the hard spotlight. Slow handheld push in. He is singing a melancholic Chinese rock ballad, male voice, electric guitar.
Slow drift over the silhouetted audience toward the hazy glowing stage, smoke swirling in the warm backlight, heads sway gently. Dreamlike, soft focus. Muffled crowd and distant band.
Static camera. The figure in the pale trench coat sits completely motionless in the last row, face in deep shadow. Dust slowly drifts through the light beam in the foreground. Silence, low rumble.
Side tracking shot moving with him as he walks slowly down the aisle, his fingertips trailing across the dusty seat backs, dust lifting into the light shafts. Sound of slow footsteps.
Extreme close-up: his hand strums the electric guitar strings hard and fast, sweat flying, stage light flaring. Loud distorted electric guitar.
The film projector lamp flickers on by itself, the reels begin to spin, the beam shoots out through the small window, dust swirling in the beam. Mechanical clatter of the projector.
Rain drops fall from above into the shallow puddle on the stage floor, ripples spread across the reflected spotlight. Slow motion. Sound of water drops.
The figure in the pale trench coat walks slowly away down the corridor and turns a corner out of sight. The bare bulb swings, shadows sway. Never see the face.
He runs hard toward the camera through the rainy neon street, camera tracking backward in front of him, rain and splashes, breathing hard.
The follow-spotlight snaps on by itself with a loud clunk, a hard white circle of light appears on the empty stage, dust floating in the beam.
Static. The older man stands still facing the cracked mirror. In the reflection, the young man slowly raises his eyes and stares straight back at him. The makeup bulb flickers. Uncanny stillness.
Static medium shot. He sits still facing the stage, unaware. Very slow rack focus from his face to the shadowy figure in the pale trench coat sitting directly behind him, face unseen.
Static close-up. The single folded-down theater seat slowly springs back up by itself with a soft thud, as if someone just stood up. Dust lifts from the seat.
He turns his head sharply to look behind him over his shoulder, then freezes, staring, fear and longing in his eyes. Shallow depth of field.
Static close-up. He stands in the spotlight breathing hard after the song, sweat on his brow, staring out into the dark audience, searching, a faint tremble in his lips.
